errorCodes.meaning: The caller may see the event but is not a host, and its roster is `hidden` (VTI-EVT-053). Nobody but the hosts reads who is registered.
The event's roster is `visible`, but the caller is not going or maybe, and is not a host. The roster is shown to those on it.
`statuses` was given by a caller who gets the roster view, which is always going and maybe.

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

EventId.description: Opaque identifier of an event: `evt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-001).
EventId.title: EventId

EventInstant.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, such as `2026-11-30T18:30:00Z`.
EventInstant.title: EventInstant

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Registration.description: One registrant's registration for one event. The registrant reads all of it; a host reads all of it; another registrant on a `visible` roster reads only `entryId`, `status` and `guests` (VTI-EVT-053). Exactly one of `entryId` (a member) and `registrantDid` (a partner's member, VTI-EVT-134) names the registrant.

answers.description: The registrant's and the hosts' view only.

codeOfConductAcknowledged.description: The `sha256` of the code of conduct the registrant acknowledged.

entryId.description: The registrant's directory entry, where they are a member. Exactly one of `entryId` and `registrantDid` is present.

eventSequence.description: The event's `sequence` when the registration last changed, so a registrant sees whether the event changed since.

note.description: A host's note on a decline or removal, shown to the registrant. Plain text.

registrantDid.description: A registrant who is not a member of the community — a partner's member (VTI-EVT-134) — by the DID they presented as. Shown to the event's hosts and to the registrant only.

roster.description: The roster setting the registration was made under (VTI-EVT-052).

waitlistPosition.description: While `waitlisted`: the registrant's place in the queue, 1 first.

Registration.title: Registration

RegistrationAnswer.description: An answer to a question: a string for `text` and `choice`, a boolean for `boolean`.
RegistrationAnswer.title: RegistrationAnswer

RegistrationId.description: Opaque identifier of one registrant's registration for one event: `reg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and unique within the community; a registrant has at most one registration per event (VTI-EVT-030).
RegistrationId.title: RegistrationId

RegistrationQuestionId.description: A question's key within its event.
RegistrationQuestionId.title: RegistrationQuestionId

RegistrationStatus.description: Where a registration stands (VTI-EVT-032). `going`: has a place. `maybe`: has said maybe; holds no place. `pending`: awaits a host's decision. `waitlisted`: waits for a place, in order. `withdrawn`: the registrant withdrew. `declined`: a host declined a pending registration. `removed`: a host removed it.
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/registrations/list/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/registrations/list/0.2#response. `registrations` is present exactly when `view` is `host`, `roster` exactly when it is `roster`.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

othersGoing.description: Roster view only: registrants going or maybe who are not members of the community — partners' members — counted, never named (VTI-EVT-134).

registrations.description: Host view: registrations in order of `createdAt`, then `registrationId`; waitlisted ones carry `waitlistPosition`.

roster.description: Roster view: registrants going or maybe, the caller included, in order of `entryId`.

Response.title: VTC Events — Registrations — List — response payload

RosterItem.description: Another registrant as the roster view shows them: who, whether going or maybe, and how many guests. Never their answers, their acknowledgement or when they registered (VTI-EVT-053).

guests.description: Plus-ones the registrant brings; 0 where none.

status.description: Whether the registrant is going or maybe; the roster view shows no other status.

RosterItem.title: RosterItem

RosterSetting.description: Who may see who is registered (VTI-EVT-050). `visible`: registrants who are going or maybe see each other. `hidden`: no registrant sees another; the event's hosts do. Fixed once the event is published (VTI-EVT-051) and recorded on each registration (VTI-EVT-052).
RosterSetting.title: RosterSetting

View.description: Which view the caller was given. `host`: the event's hosts — every registration, all of it (VTI-EVT-073). `roster`: a registrant on a `visible` roster — who else is going or maybe (VTI-EVT-053).
View.title: View

schema.description: List an event's registrations as the caller may see them: every registration, answers included, for the event's hosts; on a `visible` roster, for a registrant who is going or maybe, the others who are going or maybe — who, their status and their guests, nothing else. On a `hidden` roster nobody but the hosts reads any. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller, the event and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

statuses.description: Hosts only: only registrations in one of these statuses. Absent means every status for a host. Refused for the roster view, which is always `going` and `maybe`.

schema.title: VTC Events — Registrations — List — payload
